countsNote: Seen logged-out in the rendered profile header (154 seguidores, 60 seguidos). The page's <meta description> still said '64 siguiendo' (stale cache); 13 posts comes from the meta description and the embed footer ('13 publicaciones · 154 seguidores'), and matches the 13 grid items that loaded.
highlightsNote: Only the three titles and their 150 px cover thumbnails are visible on the logged-out profile. The stories inside the highlights (/stories/highlights/<id>/) were NOT opened: Instagram normally gates Stories behind a login and I did not poke that wall. Ask Pau for them (the 'Progress' highlight is probably process footage).
avatarNote: 150x150 px is the largest avatar Instagram serves logged-out (the same hand-drawn devil on a tan disc as ../logo/*).
capturedBy: logged-out visitor, no login / sign-up / cookies accepted (optional cookies rejected)
bioLinkNote: Link-in-bio only; the Linktree page itself was not visited (not part of this capture).
dateNote: dateISO values in manifest.json are UTC (<time datetime> on each permalink). All 13 posts were published between 10:41 and 16:47 UTC, so the calendar date is identical in UTC and in Spain (UTC+1 / UTC+2); in Sydney (UTC+11) the later ones would roll to the next day - show the 'date' string as text instead of converting it to the viewer's timezone.
